dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Mira, are you really Russian? I hear you talk about American hamburger as if you've ăn it your whole life.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Idiot! Of course I'm Russian. Just because I hate American fast food doesn't mean I don't know about it. Hamburger is the tệ thing - all fat and no flavor.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Sorry, I was just joking. But I don't think hamburger is the tệ Mỹ food. It must be candy corn - that thing is so sweet it makes my teeth hurt.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Candy corn? Haven't you ever tried American hot dogs? That's a real disaster. I don't understand how you người Mỹ can ăn that stuff every day.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Hey, I don't ăn hot dogs every day either! But I have to admit, hot dogs at baseball games are thực tệ. Hey Mira, would you like to go ăn Vietnamese food with me? I know a good phở place...

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Why would you think I want to go ăn with you? Well... phở sounds okay. But how do I know you thực understand Vietnamese cuisine?
